title: SearchPortal — Blind Boolean Report Filter
objective: The sales report's price filter is injectable, but the page never shows query results or errors — only whether any matching rows were found. Use a blind boolean injection to reach data outside the products table.

verifier.condition: The min_price filter is manipulated with a boolean subquery against the hidden vault table, and the report's true/false response genuinely reflects that subquery's real result.

weakness: A numeric filter is concatenated into a SQL query, so boolean subqueries leak data one bit at a time through the report's true/false behaviour.
seededData: SQLite: products table plus a hidden vault table; per-instance file.
solutionHint: Setting min_price to an impossibly high number should always report "no matches". If you can make it report "matches found" anyway by OR-ing in a condition about another table, you've proven you can inject boolean logic — even though you never see any data directly.
